ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Information Systems, Management, Operations Management, Marketing and Supply Chain Management students on Monday, November 18, 2024 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to undergraduate Finance and Accountancy students as well as MSF, MSM, MSBA, MSTM and Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering, Systems Engineering & Design and to Innovation, Leadership & Engineering Entrepreneurship students on Monday, November 25, 2024. There are currently 10 reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students only (any exchange students outside of GCOB who try to register will be removed); any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 24, 2025 at approximately 10:00 a.m.
